Extract climate statistics (1961-1990 and 1991-2020) from a NEVINA catchment shapefile

Source: R/custom_functions.r
fx.extract.klima.from.shp.Rd

This function reads a NEVINA catchment shapefile, extracts climate variables for the periods 1961-1990 and 1991-2020, and returns standardized climate tables together with an interactive leaflet map. The map includes a static information panel in the bottom-left corner showing a combined climate table (wide format) with values rounded to two decimals, and a small popup table displayed when clicking the catchment polygon.

Usage

fx.extract.klima.from.shp(
  shpfile,
  params6190 = "klima6190.csv",
  params9120 = "klima9120.csv",
  plot.map = TRUE,
  map.width = "1200px",
  map.height = "900px",
  fontsize = 12,
  sep.klima = ";",
  station_name = "Station",
  station_lon = NULL,
  station_lat = NULL
)

Arguments

shpfile

Character. Path to the NEVINA shapefile (e.g., "NedbfeltF_v4.shp").

params6190

Character. Output file path for the 1961-1990 climate table (default "klima6190.csv").

params9120

Character. Output file path for the 1991-2020 climate table (default "klima9120.csv").

plot.map

Logical. If TRUE, an interactive leaflet map is generated and returned (default TRUE).

map.width

Character. Width of the leaflet map widget (default "1200px").

map.height

Character. Height of the leaflet map widget (default "900px").

fontsize

Numeric. Font size (px) used in the DT climate table (default 12).

sep.klima

Character. Field separator used when writing CSV files (default ";").

station_name

Character. Name of station (default "Station").

station_lon

Numeric. Longitude of station (default NULL).

station_lat

Numeric. Latitude of station (default NULL).

Value

A list containing:

s

The sf object read from the shapefile.

s.tab

The attribute table with geometry removed.

klima6190

Data frame of standardized climate variables for 1961-1990.

klima9120

Data frame of standardized climate variables for 1991-2020.

klima.tbl

A DT::datatable object showing both climate periods.

map

A leaflet map object with static info panel and popup tables (if plot.map = TRUE).
